profile.headline: Computer Software Professional
profile.summary:
I am a software developer with 5 years of professional software development experience and an additional 10+ years of software development experience through school and personal projects. My greatest strength is  my resourcefulness and ability to adapt. I am willing to learn new programming languages, switch to different development models, and familiarize myself with completely new software concepts. I believe it is imperative to remain flexible and be willing to overcome any challenges that present themselves.

In my current role I am a crucial part of the engineering department as I am the principal back end developer for the 3D module of our product. This is in addition to helping with developing front end features for the 3D module using ThreeJS and helping to maintain the other features in our product. This role presents significant challenges as there is often no one else at the company that is familiar with my work. Hence when a problem presents itself I have no internal resources to call upon and must research everything on my own.

I also have a hobby as a solo amateur game developer. This means that I must learn how to develop every part of a game on my own. This includes the design, the structure of all the code, and the development of all code and other assets. There are many challenges, but it's a hobby I find very fulfilling and educational.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I was promoted after my first annual review. In addition to my previous responsibilities, I was also put onto increasingly important roles. I helped revamp the login security system of our product and implemented a new hashing algorithm. I implemented file validation for file uploads when there was no validation before. I am currently the only back end developer for our ever growing 3D viewer tool.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description: I contributed to both the front end and back end of the codebase. Every release cycle I had to learn new features in our software and how to expand them to meet our goals for that release.I was able to learn a great deal from more experienced members of my team and from the principal engineers in the company.

positions.title: Front end development intern
positions.description: I used HTML, AngularJS, and Javascript to write the front end portion of the application. We then use Phonegap to convert it into an app for iOS and Android. We had weekly SCRUM meetings to touch base and plan out the week's goals.

positions.title: Support Engineer
positions.description: My role encompassed anything the company required. These duties included programming, answering support calls for the data center, managing servers and equipment for customers, managing the front desk, troubleshooting customer issues, managing customer hardware, and much more.

positions.title: Format QA
positions.description: Intern position for SCEA which led to a contracted position. Performed Functionality testing and TRC (Technical Requirements Checklist) testing on various test cycles in a team environment. Received professional training on bug tracking and bug reporting. Contracted to Nelson Staffing from February 2012 to July 2012 and to WorkforceLogic from July 2012 to March 2013
